review_candidates.title: Senior Systems Administrator, Virtual Desktop & Infrastructure Services
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Title Senior Systems Administrator, Virtual Desktop & Infrastructure Services At KBR, we deliver science, technology and engineering solutions to governments and companies around the world. The Senior Systems Administrator, Virtual Desktop & Infrastructure Services is responsible for the administration, support, and continuous improvement of enterprise virtual desktop and infrastructure platforms that enable secure, reliable, and scalable technology services across the organization. This role se
eligibility_evidence: Our people work at the frontier of what is possible, delivering solutions in challenging environments and advancing some of the world's highest-priority national security and space missions.

This role serves as a key contributor within the Corporate IT Infrastructure team, supporting Omnissa Horizon and Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop environments while also administering core infrastructure technologies including Windows Server, VMware virtualization, storage, backup, and hybrid cloud
Experience supporting hybrid on premises and cloud infrastructure environments.
Additional compensation may be in the form of sign on bonus, relocation benefits, short term incentives, long term incentives, or discretionary payments for exceptional performance.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Backed by decades of mission success, deep expertise, and trusted partnerships, Trinzic will launch as a global organization with more than 18,000 employees supporting customers around the world. Basic Qualifications Education & Experience Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field. 7+ years of progressive information technology experience with hands-on experience administering and supporting enterprise virtual desktop environments utilizing Omnissa Horizon and/or Microsoft Azure Virtual Desktop. Preferred Qualifications Experience supporting VMware Cloud Foundation environments.
